description: Each provider’s composite value combines one value from every workload, with workloads weighted equally.
definition: A composite combines one value per workload, with each workload counting equally.

time.what_this_measures: Measures each provider’s execution times across coding and CI workloads combined into one composite time.
time.how_it_is_measured: Published per-unit times from {workloads:time-index}, evaluated on the selected unit metric (median by default, mean, or p95).
time.how_to_read: A geometric mean is only comparable over the same set of workloads, so a workload a provider failed entirely takes the worst workload value. Every provider stays in the composite, so a provider can't rank higher by failing the traces it is slow on.
time.legacy_how_to_read: A unit missing for any provider is excluded for every provider.
time.what_this_measures_concise: The composite time per provider is the geometric mean of each workload's median times across {workloads:time-index}, each weighted equally.
time.cost_how_to_read: The time and cost views use the same workload boundaries.
time.cost_summary: Cost follows the successful workload results included in each provider value.
time.calculation: For each workload, compute the geometric mean of its unit times (substituting the slowest provider’s time on any uncompleted unit), then take the equal-weighted geometric mean across the workloads in the selected scope.

cost.what_this_measures: Measures each provider’s sandbox costs across coding and CI workloads combined into one composite cost.
cost.how_it_is_measured: Published per-unit provider-sourced costs from {workloads:cost-index} over successful trials on the selected unit metric (median by default, mean, or p95).
cost.how_to_read: The method includes exact costs from successful trials only. A workload a provider failed entirely takes the highest workload cost, and every provider stays in the composite, so none ranks higher by failing the traces it is slow on.
cost.what_this_measures_concise: The composite cost per provider is the geometric mean of each workload's median costs across {workloads:cost-index}, each weighted equally.
cost.calculation: For each workload, compute the geometric mean of its unit costs (substituting the highest provider cost on any uncompleted unit), then take the equal-weighted geometric mean across the workloads in the selected scope.

time_score.what_this_measures: Averages each provider's workload time scores, from 0 to 100, where 100 is the fastest provider on every unit.
time_score.how_it_is_measured: A unit scores 100 times the best provider's time divided by this provider's time; a workload scores the mean over its whole unit set, and the composite is the mean of the workload scores. A unit without a result adds no points.
time_score.how_to_read: Higher is better. A provider that fails a unit or a workload loses points; nothing is substituted for it.

cost_score.what_this_measures: Averages each provider's workload cost scores, from 0 to 100, where 100 is the cheapest provider on every unit.
cost_score.how_it_is_measured: A unit scores 100 times the best provider's cost divided by this provider's cost; a workload scores the mean over its whole unit set, and the composite is the mean of the workload scores. A unit without a result adds no points.
cost_score.how_to_read: Higher is better. A provider that fails a unit or a workload loses points; nothing is substituted for it.

time_vs_cost.what_this_measures: Displays each provider’s {name:index.time-index} and {name:index.cost-index} on a frontier graph.
time_vs_cost.how_it_is_measured: The provider’s Execution-scope {name:index.cost-index} and its {name:index.time-index} computed over the same costed units on the selected unit metric (median by default, mean, or p95).
time_vs_cost.how_to_read: Lower elapsed time and lower cost appear toward the lower left.
time_vs_cost.calculation: Pairs each qualifying provider’s two composite geometric means as a single (x, y) point with no additional timing or cost calculation.

provider_score.what_this_measures: Averages four scores for each provider, each from 0 to 100: workload time, workload cost, sandbox operations and machine performance.
provider_score.how_it_is_measured: A unit's score is averaged up to its suite, then its subsection, then workload time and cost; an operation's or machine test's score compares providers in its default configuration. A child without results adds 0.
provider_score.how_to_read: Higher is better. A provider without a result on a child loses its points; nothing is substituted for it.
provider_score.what_this_measures_four_scores: Averages four scores for each provider, each from 0 to 100: workload time, workload cost, sandbox operations and machine performance.

descriptions.time: A {quantity:typical_time} statistic is aggregated from each workload's {units:time-index}.
descriptions.cost: A {quantity:typical_cost} statistic is aggregated from each workload's {units:cost-index}.
descriptions.provider_score: A provider score is averaged from its workload time, workload cost, sandbox operations and machine performance scores.
